description: This header file defines APIs, constants, structures, and enums for managing WAN traffic data, including configuration, thread management, and traffic counting, within the COSA Data Model Library for network devices.

methods.name: WTC_SetConfig
methods.description: Sets syscfg parameters related to WAN traffic configuration.

methods.name: WTC_GetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves syscfg parameters related to WAN traffic configuration.

methods.name: WTC_Init
methods.description: Initializes the WAN traffic count data structures.

methods.name: WTC_ApplyStateChange
methods.description: Fetches input parameters and updates thread states accordingly.

methods.name: WTC_GetCount
methods.description: Retrieves WAN traffic counts, either total or per interval.

methods.name: WTC_EventPublish
methods.description: Publishes WAN traffic events to Rbus.
